newsitem.title: USA: Merrill recommends memory chip stocks Micron, TI.
newsitem.headline: Merrill recommends memory chip stocks Micron, TI.

text.p: Merrill Lynch analyst Thomas Kurlak said that the recent pullback in semiconductor stocks is due to portfolio selling and that memory chip stocks Micron Technology and Texas Instruments have the most upside potential, a Merrill source said.
"Our recommendations remain Micron and Texas Instruments," Kurlak said in a note to clients, adding that unit demand for PCs remains strong. Memory chips are a big component of PCs.
Micron Technology closed up 2-5/8 at 36-7/8 and was the most active issue on the NYSE. Shares of Texas Instruments rose 2-3/4 and closed at 82-1/8.
